interaction.method: actual UI speed buttons, mouse wheel, middle-button drag; proof port read-only

limits: Motion uses normal 1x simulation; frame tick thresholds may overshoot and are recorded. Compare exact initial states, not assumed identical live frame states.
Requested and loaded images do not prove visible drawing. Draw samples are bounded.
No video is synthesized: numbered actual-game PNG/JPEG frames are the moving evidence.
classification: Original recorded errors retained. Telemetry POST cancellation is separate from game/image failures; root cause not established.
